title: Explain and improve a utility
description: Inspect a date formatter, fix its empty state, and verify the result.

turns.prompt: Why does the date label show Invalid Date when a task has no due date?

events.text:
The formatter passes an empty value directly to `new Date()`. An empty string produces an invalid date, which gets displayed as the label.

An early return can give undated tasks a useful label.

turns.prompt: Show No due date for missing values. Handle malformed dates too.

events.name: replace

events.text:
✓ formats a valid date
✓ handles undefined and null
✓ handles an empty string
✓ handles a malformed date

4 tests passed
Missing and malformed values now display **No due date**. Valid dates keep their existing format. All four tests pass.
